return c
end

local function DMVTL_fake_script() -- ImageButton.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', ImageButton)

	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	
	local image = script.Parent
	
	-- Save original values
	local originalPos = image.Position
	local originalSize = image.Size
	
	-- Start off-screen
	image.Position = UDim2.new(-1, 0, originalPos.Y.Scale, originalPos.Y.Offset)
	
	-- Tween info
	local flyInfo = TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local pulseInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	
	-- Center position
	local centerPos = UDim2.new(
		0.5, -image.AbsoluteSize.X / 2,
		0.5, -image.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
	)
	
	-- Slightly bigger size for pulse
	local pulseSize = UDim2.new(
		originalSize.X.Scale * 1.3,
		originalSize.X.Offset * 1.3,
		originalSize.Y.Scale * 1.3,
		originalSize.Y.Offset * 1.3
	)
	
	-- Fly tweens
	local flyIn = TweenService:Create(image, flyInfo, { Position = centerPos })
	local flyOut = TweenService:Create(image, flyInfo, { Position = originalPos })
	
	-- Pulse tweens
	local zoomIn = TweenService:Create(image, pulseInfo, { Size = pulseSize })
	local zoomOut = TweenService:Create(image, pulseInfo, { Size = originalSize })
	
	-- Play fly in
	flyIn:Play()
	flyIn.Completed:Wait()
	
	-- Pulse for 3 seconds
	local startTime = tick()
	while tick() - startTime < 3 do
		zoomIn:Play()
		zoomIn.Completed:Wait()
	
		zoomOut:Play()
		zoomOut.Completed:Wait()
	end
	
	-- Fly back
	flyOut:Play()
	
end

local function RKHLIQ_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	-- If the script is in a ScreenGui, grab the first Frame
	if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		gui = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
	end
	
	if not gui then
		warn("No Frame found to drag")
		return
	end
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end

        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)

        Settings[name] = val
        label.Text = name .. ": " .. string.format("%.2f", val)
        
        -- Animation für Füllung und Thumb
        TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(thumb, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Position = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 0.5, 0)}):Play()

        isOpen = true
        uiScale.Scale = 0

        notifLabel.Visible = false
    else

        close.Completed:Connect(function()

            notifLabel.TextTransparency = 1

            task.wait(3)
            if not isOpen then
                TweenService:Create(notifLabel, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            end
        end)
    end
end

local originalCollisionStates = {}

    for _, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do

    for _, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= humanoidRootPart then p.CanCollide = false end
    end
end
local function restoreCollisions()
    for p, state in pairs(originalCollisionStates) do
        if p and p.Parent then p.CanCollide = state end
    end
    originalCollisionStates = {}
end

saveCollisions()

        if lastFixClipState ~= current then
            if current then saveCollisions() disableCollisions() else restoreCollisions() end
            lastFixClipState = current
        elseif current then
            disableCollisions()
        end
    end
end)
